phase: P1 sixth increment: typed opening gate, explicit safety context and admitted-intent preparation recovery
implemented: Mandatory immutable features.execution binds exact plan/account, entry and liquidity controls and shared price/reentry policy. Present malformed typed evidence never falls back to directional fields.

Typed plan branch in existing venue gate; persisted full OPEN request identity and current safety checks run before settings. MARKET/full-plan only; canonical plan, capital and portfolio risk budgets remain required. No legacy sizing-model enablement is required just to submit a pre-sized plan.

Mandatory exact two-sided frozen price drift and stop-side checks plus tighter current/frozen optional shared price guard. Existing venue settings/readback, account inventory, original reservation checks and real committed readiness baseline precede POST.

Typed entry/liquidity controls compare frozen snapshots with current committed state. Unsupported remaining-budget, history SOFT, reentry ENFORCE or shared reentry modes explicitly reject; SHADOW does not veto. Enforced liquidity reuses neutral book/quote evaluators with plan price, source/freshness and no post-decision timestamps.

Bound reduction submissions validate persisted CLOSE identity independently of entry/deployment/expiry. An OPEN snapshot cannot be relabeled CLOSE/reduceOnly to reach transport. Prevalidation failures are definitely unsent; downstream submission exceptions remain ambiguous.

Typed prepare recovery validates original plan and permanent opportunity receipt under intent/account locks, invokes existing Orders.prepare in the same transaction, and returns only after commit. Existing/terminal/ambiguous order states are not revived or resent.
Only PG-proven expired, order-free RECEIVED intents become EXPIRED. Bounded candidate pages isolate row failures, carry explicit cursor and whitelist diagnostics; no scheduler or dispatcher enabled.

Genuine fake-venue acceptance traverses guarded BUY/SELL OPEN, query-recorded fills, native protection, frozen exit after expiry/deployment OFF, cash reconciliation, settlement and reservation release. No synthetic opening baseline or direct opening journal fill shortcut.

Legacy and typed full/partial reductions additionally accepted through the real bound gate and Runner with explicitly synthetic opening-exposure fixtures; entry ports fail if touched, tamper is definitely unsent and POST timeout recovers query-only.

qa.boundary: One disposable PG/Redis harness at a time; Unix sockets only and V2 conftest external TCP block. No running trading database, exchange or service activation.
qa.scope: 69 selected files in two disjoint runs: 68-file regression (2357 passed) plus one 14-case reduction identity supplement. Not the whole repository or real exchange acceptance.

intermediate_runs.note: Real success cases rejected because first adapter incorrectly required legacy capital.model_enabled. Removed that unrelated sizing requirement; mandatory capital.enabled and portfolio_risk.enabled remain. No risk thresholds relaxed.
Opening-only rerun before later reduction hardening and added PG control cases; overlaps final regression.

supplemental_reduction.scope: Committed legacy/typed full/partial CLOSE identities, entry-proof independence, tamper rejection and response-loss query recovery; explicitly synthetic opening fills only for these reduction-callback tests.

read_only_service_observation.scope: Service metadata only; no fresh exchange positions queried.

remaining_before_activation: Different TV/S3 signals representing the same opportunity still require audited IGNORED consumption. The permanent claim prevents a second order but does not yet terminalize every duplicate signal.
Independent typed entry worker and bounded settlement process, explicit process ownership and shutdown, signal/candidate dispatch wiring. Existing running pipeline OPEN producer scope is unchanged.

Submission CAS remains authority. Additional typed checks can reject known-unsent initial attempts, but a deployment change after the last check is not an atomic transport revocation. Ambiguous submissions retain query-only recovery.
Explicit unsupported typed controls need neutral equivalents or an explicit OFF configuration before activation; no hidden bypass.

Preparation cursor must be carried/reset by its future caller. LIMIT bounds returned rows, not examined historical rows or whole-batch duration; per-lock/per-statement timeouts are not a wall-clock budget. Index/load/cadence acceptance pending.

Shared protocol-account locks can still make management BUSY behind settlement. Overall signed-request deadlines, idle transaction limits, controller alert/dashboard management-heartbeat projection and fault/load deployment acceptance remain.

P2 causal opportunity comparison, two deterministic strategy families, same-window portfolio replay, research/outcome projections and out-of-sample evidence are not delivered by this engineering increment.
profitability_claim: None. Trading remains paused; fake-venue engineering acceptance is not Testnet deployment or profitability evidence.
independent_review: Independent control/prepare/opening audits found no remaining blocking defect in the frozen increment. Review prompted CLOSE identity hardening and explicit real-PG legacy/partial reduction acceptance. Generic forged-close fixture was corrected rather than weakening identity checks.
